thread:
Mira Patel: Evening handoff — 18:00-02:00. Quick notes + watchlist. TL;DR: small model canary, infra maintenance window tomorrow, expect noisy mem-alerts on staging.

Mira Patel: What changed since morning:
- Canary deploy of text-generation v2.3 started at 17:30 (10% traffic). Metrics look fine so far.
- Increased KV-cache TTL on hosted-prod to 6h to reduce backend spikes (see runbook link).
- Applied emergency patch to embedding worker retries (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1123).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: text-generation:v2.3 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-17T17:30Z. No errors > 5m.

Mira Patel: What to watch overnight:
- Latency: 95th for /v1/generate on region-us-west. If 95th > 450ms for 5m, escalate to Alex.
- Embedding queue backpressure on staging — we saw retries after the patch; monitor queue depth > 1000.
- KV-cache evictions: if evictions spike > 200/sec, roll TTL back.

Alex Chen: I can take first escalation on latency. Pager config unchanged; I'm primary until 23:00 PT.

Jordan Park: I'll watch embedding queue and retries. I'll mute non-actionable noisy alerts if they are duplicates.

Mira Patel: Action items for night:
- Alex: watch /v1/generate 95th and confirm canary metrics at 22:00. (alert link: https://go/redwood/alerts/latency)
- Jordan: follow embedding queue; if retry-rate > 5% open a ticket and notify infra.
- Priya: FYI — scheduled config rollout for batching changes at 01:30; should be low-risk but expect small warmups.

Priya Singh: Confirmed. Config rollout (batch-size tweaks) scheduled 01:30-02:00 PT, non-blocking. I'll post progress updates in this thread.

Sam Ortiz: Infra FYI — nightly storage compaction for logs at 00:15 in us-west. It may cause short CPU bumps on logging nodes; not expected to affect inference but flag if correlating with errors.

Mira Patel: Runbook & play links:
- Hot latency play: https://go/redwood/runbooks/latency-playbook
- Embedding retry runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/emb-retries

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall swap window in 6 hours. Next primary: Alex Chen until 23:00 PT, then Jordan Park 23:00-03:00 PT.

Alex Chen: Quick note on rollback guard: if canary error-rate > 1% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, automatic rollback is configured. I'll be ready to manually abort if false positives.

Jordan Park: If embedding queue grows due to a downstream DB lag, call out to @infra on Slack and escalate to infra oncall (paging rules in runbook).

Priya Singh: If batching rollout causes a spike in 5xx, I'll immediately revert. I'll post the rollout progress: START -> VALIDATE -> COMPLETE.

Mira Patel: Handing off checklist done: alerts reviewed, runbooks linked, owners tagged, pager handoff confirmed. My contact: mira.patel@redwood.com if you need context.

Sam Ortiz: Servers to watch: logging-rt-*/us-west, emb-queue-worker-*/staging, gen-serving-*/prod-us-west.

Alex Chen: I'll check back at 22:00 for canary metrics, ping here with numbers. Good luck everyone. :rocket:

Priya Singh: Starting rollout at 01:30 -> will update here.

Jordan Park: Noted. I'll mute duplicate retry alerts and escalate real regressions.

Mira Patel: Thanks team — signing off. (thumbsup)
